title: Operator switches in platform_flags are no longer readable with the public anon key

verify.note: Probe reads the migration and every platform_flags reader. Live check: pg_policies has no row for platform_flags and anon has no select.

detail: Measured 2026-11-02: policy 'platform_flags: public read' (using true) lets anon read all 33 switches, including billing_live, host_payouts_enabled, vera_autonomy_enabled, vera_breaker_armed and domain_purchase_enabled. Every app reader uses createAdminClient (checked by the probe). Expected lift: outsiders cannot see which money or AI paths are armed.
